clinical_intent: I need to develop a protocol for image acquisition during brachytherapy fractions for cervical cancer IGABT. The protocol should specify: (1) imaging modality selection (CT vs MRI vs both), (2) imaging protocol at each fraction (sequences, planes, resolution), (3) applicator filling protocol for MRI, (4) timing of imaging relative to applicator insertion, (5) image quality assessment criteria, and (6) decision criteria for repeating images. Please provide detailed specifications.
